_about: THE ONE LIST. Each core idea of Demismatch next to its short mainstream form. check.py reads this file; so do the briefs, the gate and the session start. Change an idea here and nowhere else. Maarten, 21 Nov 2026: 'We need a failsafe foolproof harness in place to not have our own project shoot itself in the foot again by sheer dumbness.'

scopes.page: text a visitor reads on any of our sites
scopes.cor: Cor's own text: foundations, mechanisms, baseline rows, convergences, applications
scopes.brief: anything that instructs an agent or a model: briefs, rules, prompts, CLAUDE.md, memory

concepts.ours: Undo the mismatch: move a person's conditions toward what humans evolved for, as Cor's baseline rows state it (people around you in Dunbar circles, reciprocity, a role).
concepts.why: On 21 Nov 2026 the short form let studies of money, vouchers and stress classes count as evidence against the project.
concepts.ask: Changed toward what? Name the baseline row.
concepts.needs_nearby: evolved for|baseline|mismatch|how humans lived|what humans|what a human|EEA|Dunbar|people who (know|need)|toward what|circles of

concepts.ours: A study is evidence about us only when it measured a baseline value moving. Money, a move, a class, a flat or a job among strangers moves none: no evidence for us and none against us.
concepts.short: people got X and felt better, or no better
concepts.why: A generic change proves nothing in either direction. Used as proof it is the mirror of the 21 Nov error.
concepts.ask: Which baseline value did the study move? If none, it is no evidence.
patterns: \b(cash transfers?|cash for|basic income|income supplement|lottery (win|winners?|wealth)|voucher|debt relief|housing first|wellness program(me)?s?|mindfulness (class|course|training)|resilience (training|class)|stress[- ]management (training|class|course)|found work|returned? to work|job training|vocational (training|program(me)?s?|rehabilitation)|supported employment)\b[^.]{0,160}\b(lower|rais|reduc|improv|cut|fell|rose|did not|no effect|went with|better|worse|changed|chang)
concepts.needs_nearby: EEA-[A-Z]+-\d+|baseline value|no test|moves? no|moved no|generic change|no evidence|proves nothing

concepts.ours: People who know you and need you, and give back; circles of about 5, 15, 50 and 150.
concepts.why: A 'social support' programme run by helpers is no band of people who need you. Mainstream studies of the short form then count for or against us.
concepts.ask: Did the people know and need the person, and did the person give back?

concepts.ours: A stand-in sets off a system without meeting what the system is for. What is missing does the harm; the hours on a stand-in are not the measure.
concepts.short: screen time; social media causes depression
concepts.why: Hours on a device are a medium frame. The medium is neutral.
concepts.ask: What is the stand-in standing in for, and is that thing missing?

concepts.ours: Esteem is given and taken by the people around you.
concepts.why: Esteem worked up alone is a stand-in.

concepts.ours: Only a clear physical defect is a disease, found or not yet found. Otherwise the reaction is a normal human response to a mismatched world. No label is carved out.
concepts.short: mental illness, brain disease, chemical imbalance
concepts.why: Disease wording for anything without a defect is the frame the project rejects.
concepts.ask: Is a physical defect the cause? If not, no disease or disorder wording in our voice.

concepts.ours: What happened to a person as a child explains little of how they feel now. Genes and the world they live in now explain most. The exception is deprivation far outside anything a human child evolved for.
concepts.short: your trauma, healing your inner child, trauma-informed
concepts.why: The mainstream trauma frame puts the cause in the past and the fix in the person.
concepts.ask: Is the cause in the person's world now?

concepts.ours: The medication line travels whole: the drug gets replaced by the real thing; it comes down while the real thing comes in; where stopping suddenly is dangerous, never stop suddenly, and do it with a doctor.
concepts.why: One half without the other is the regression Maarten named on 18 Nov 2026.
concepts.ask: Are the replacement and the sudden-stop warning both in this text?

require_all: \b(never stop suddenly|stop(ping)? suddenly|sudden stop|at once can)\b

concepts.ours: Claim first, at full force. A study missing from Cor is a gap in Cor, never a weakness of the claim.
concepts.short: no study in Cor; this is our reading
concepts.why: Maarten, 21 Nov 2026: such lines 'are completely unnecessarily tanking the entire project'.
concepts.ask: Is this a gap in Cor printed as a weakness of the claim?

concepts.ours: The permanent prohibitions in the project CLAUDE.md.
concepts.short: salt water for thirst; what a human being is; mismatch broke the brain
concepts.why: Each has its reason in CLAUDE.md, Permanent Prohibitions.
concepts.ask: Is this one of the banned framings?

concepts.ours: A finding is filed against Cor only with the quoted sentence of Cor's own text it contradicts, and only if the study measured the same thing.
concepts.short: a study that cuts against a claim goes in as a challenge
concepts.why: This sentence stood in every research brief and caused the wrong filings of 21 Nov 2026.
concepts.ask: Does the instruction name cor_sentence and same_measure?
concepts.needs_nearby: cor_sentence|same_measure|sentence of Cor|quoted sentence|NOT a challenge|not a challenge|ONLY when
